title: The Truce Field's free 'weigh what this grief asks' is otherwise excellent and always matched reality (verses, truce-words, refusals all tracked live and correctly) — but it never once mentioned the parallel 'Field's Stone' quest as a factor, so nothing warned that brokering the stone and then bargaining the field could leave two contradictory outcomes on record; a player trusting the weighing tool alone would have zero warning of the clash documented above.
